title: Classification of finite Euclidean Ramsey configurations

result.label: Classification of finite Euclidean Ramsey configurations
result.statement: Classifies finite point configurations that occur monochromatically, at their original scale, in every finite coloring of sufficiently high-dimensional Euclidean space. The characterization is an algebraic condition over the coordinate field. It also disproves the Leader–Russell–Walters conjecture that every such configuration is a subset of a finite transitive set.
